args.summary: checkout-api health checks began failing after the v2.3.1 production deploy. Attempted rollback to the most recent healthy release v2.3.0, but it was blocked because v2.3.0 is quarantined due to CVE-2026-4417. Rolled back all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to v2.2.9 instead. Rollback completed and verified. Needs follow-up: remediate CVE-2026-4417 in v2.3.0, investigate the v2.3.1 failure, and plan a forward fix.
args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.2.9

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary:

**Issue:** checkout-api failing health checks after the v2.3.1 production deploy.

**Actions taken:**
1. **Reviewed deployment history** — v2.3.1 (latest) was unhealthy in production; the most recent healthy release was v2.3.0.
2. **First rollback attempt to v2.3.0 failed** — v2.3.0 is quarantined due to CVE-2026-4417, so it could not be used.
3. **Rolled back to v2.2.9** (the next most recent healthy production release) — successfully rolled out to all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west).
4. **Opened SEV2 incident INC-0001** — paged on-call, documenting the v2.3.1 failure, the quarantined v2.3.0 blocker, and the rollback to v2.2.9.
5. **Verified service health** — checkout-api is now healthy on v2.2.9 across all regions, with a low error rate (0.2%).

**Follow-ups for the incident:** remediate CVE-2026-4417 in v2.3.0, investigate root cause of the v2.3.1 failure, and plan a forward fix.
